profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer - Asst. Vice President at Wells Fargo
profile.summary: Full Stack Senior Software Developer with 14 years of experience leading multidisciplinary teams whether onshore and offshore, with a strong knowledge of software architecture and the whole development cycle of an application. Outstanding organizational skills and team-building talents; committed to the timely provision of first-class products and services within budget parameters.

positions.title: Software Developer Technology Lead
positions.description:
Scrum team lead; Management of onshore and offshore team on a daily basis; Coaching and one-on-one tutoring; Check the code for review and best practices. Helping the team to get the best approach in development; Ensure quality of the delivery; Making sure everyone has a balanced workload; Daily meeting with offshore abt scope for each iteration.

Awards:
- Spot Award: For Consistency in leading complex tech projects with Quality code. Aug 2019.
- Spot Award: Acknowledging the splendid work in the last quarter. Dec 2018.
- Best Team Oct-Dec 2018.
- Insta Award Certificate of Appreciation: Excellent tech understanding, being a fast learner and making a big positive impact to the team. Aug 2018.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Part of my tasks was to define technologies and platforms, selecting which technology should be used for each project, make decisions on how to apply technologies, design and develop the application architecture, control and monitoring the activities of the development team, coaching, and one-on-one tutoring.

Major Contributions:
- Mi Claro Admin: Customer services application for the call center and customer support agents. 
- Mi Claro: An iOS and Android mobile application that offers information and additional services to Claro Puerto Rico customers.
- Mi Claro Express: An iOS app to make paymenst for postpaid and prepaid mobile services in the Claro Puerto Rico stores. 
- Mi Claro Collection Path: A web application to allow the user with canceled services to make the payment and then reconnect the services to the platform.

positions.title: Service Director / Co-founder
positions.description:
I funded my own company in 2010 with two partners, where I took different roles, from software architect, to project leader. I worked and led a team of sixteen professional developers, designers and content managers on projects based in different times zones and geographical locations, like Caracas - Venezuela, Panamá City - Panamá, Lima - Perú, Bogota - Colombia, Miami - USA.
Part of my roles was assigning tasks, project planning, designing the architecture, assigning resources to project, coaching and one-on-one tutoring.

Projects:
- NBA Mostre Sua Paixao: A web and web mobile applications for the NBA  Games Brasil 2013.  Miami. USA.
- Rey: Responsive web application for the major supermarket group in Panama,  Rey supermarket. Panama City, Panama.
- Pepsi Music 2013: Mobile and Web application for the Pepsi  Music Awards, where the user could vote to select the bands, the juries could vote in 2 rounds to select the bands and marketing team of Pepsi could select the winner and processed the information for the awards. Caracas. Venezuela.
- Pepsi Music 2012: Mobile & Web application for the Pepsi  Music Awards, where the user could vote to select the bands, the juries could vote in 2 rounds to select the bands and marketing team of Pepsi could select the winner and processed the information for the awards. Caracas. Venezuela.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Providing a comprehensive oversight of project related activities from Caracas, Venezuela location.  Gathering and assessment of the client requirements to develop a system architecture designed to create highly scalable, high performing, rich web applications.  Managing the day-to-day project activities to ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget.  Provide coaching and support to team members in order to ensure a quality end product that is in compliance with the company standards and customer specifications.  
 
Projects:
- Perfil20.com: a web application to show the results of laboratory exams on clinic environment, the application it’s integrated with SMS, EMAIL, which provide to the users to find the results throw a secure connection on a web or mobile connection.
- Orinoco: A B2B software integrated with Amazon S3, that offers secure REST web services and rich web interfaces, oriented to provide methods to upload, shared, and manipulate media on the Internet in a private way.
- Sharekoo.com: a web application integrated with the Orinoco platform which provides email, file storage, private file sharing.
- Twitalbums.com: a web application integrated with the Orinoco platform which provides Twitter users with a private way to share and manipulate media on the internet.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
I played the dual position as a project leader and senior developer, performing project management, design, and operations management.

Projects:
- 123.com.ve: A web application to bring information provided by the company, and give value-added services to the final user. This app allows users to view their current balance, as well as the ability to purchase pins for international calls, as the option of web conferencing and web international calls.
- IVR Alo 123: IVR for international call services throw VOIP, which is integrated with the charging module to process international calls.  
- 123 Conferencia:  Development conference module for value-added services in the IVR Alo  123.

positions.title: Junior System Specialties
positions.description: I was part of the systems department assigned to the roaming group. Roaming standard GSM Associations Tap 3.4, Tap 3.11 / Technical and functional interchange between 755 international operators, tests, configuration, pursuit, and control in commercial agreements or tests.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Member of the technology department, develop web application to solve client requirements
Java, PHP, MySQL, javascript - AJAX (jQuery), .Net, Adobe Flash Action Script, Microsoft SQL, Linux, Asterisk (VOIP Server), HTML, DHTML, XML, VoiceXML
